name: snackbar
description: A short message with at most one action. No close X — timeout or swipe leaves.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a decision that needs a title; use confirm-dialog. Do not stack two actions.

ux.behaviour: The message is the whole point; an action is optional and one word
ux.why: A snackbar is a whisper, not a form

ux.behaviour: The action fires a click haptic and onAction
ux.why: Undo should feel like a tap, not a hunt

ux.behaviour: There is no close X; the host owns duration
ux.why: Dismissing a whisper should not be a chore

aiHints: One action, usually Undo; do not add a close icon
Host this in a SnackbarHost; this is the surface
